messages.subject: Re: Brew: expert application - No valid input ?
parts:
Jeff, let me first tell you that I am impressed with the work you have
done in this project - pretty much converting R into a new server-side
scripting language. I would envision that it could develop into a
complete replacement of R GUI, running R workspace in an AJAX-enabled
text area in the browser.
I would be happy to help to fix the stuff, but I would need guidance
from you. One thing I noticed that useR2007.rhtml refers to src="/
prototype.js" and src="/useR2007.js", but they both are one level up,
not in the brew folder. Could this be a problem?

Thanks again - great job,

Vladimir
